The pose auditor flagged HIGH artifact risk (49% low-confidence keypoints), corroborating these anatomical ambiguities at contact points. While visually appealing from a distance, close inspection reveals AI generation flaws in limb rendering and body boundaries that prevent a higher authenticity score.
